name: Toilets
description: Toilets for patients and visitors: a row of cubicles along the back wall (about one for every metre of wall, up to 6), wash basins and a hand dryer. Waiting patients get up to use them now and then, and walk out sooner if the hospital has none.
staffing: None: cleaned by the hospital's cleaning contract, part of the building's upkeep.

name: Accessible toilet
description: A single toilet room with space to turn a wheelchair, grab rails, a low basin and a red emergency pull cord. Older patients use it first, and anyone may use it when the other toilets are busy.
staffing: None: cleaned by the hospital's cleaning contract, part of the building's upkeep.

name: Staff toilet
description: A small toilet for staff only. Staff on a break pop in now and then; without one they use the public toilets.
